name: Automatic salience suppression
fact: Automatic salience suppression is one of three banner processing modes identified in a process model of how banner processing evolves (alongside automatic salience capture and controlled salience suppression).
boundary: This mode is identified as a distinct stage in the evolution of banner processing.

provenance.title: Solving the Distinctiveness - Blindness Debate: A Unified Model for Understanding Banner Processing
provenance.quote_or_locus: we develop a process model that shows the transitions between three banner processing modes – automatic salience capture, controlled salience suppression, and automatic salience suppression
